Reference: the approved Xiaohei character sheet. Xiaohei is a minimalist pure matte black cartoon cat mascot made of
flocked vinyl, cream ring eyes with black pupils, no nose, no whiskers — keep the design exactly. Xiaohei has NO mouth
in every shot — no mouth line, no opening, no smile; expressions come only from the eyes and ears.
Style: premium consumer-electronics product commercial, seamless white studio background (#F4F4F2), soft shadowless
light, gentle rim light on the black silhouette, macro lens, very shallow depth of field, slow and precise
motion-control camera, clean cool-white grade. No text, no captions, no logos, no humans, no real cat fur.

Close-up of Xiaohei in 3/4 view, no mouth at any time. Small flat UI objects — a chat bubble, a web page card, a PDF icon, an RSS icon, a video play icon — fly in one by one from the frame edges and sink into Xiaohei's black velvet body like drops falling into ink, each leaving a soft cream ripple of light at the contact point. After the last one, Xiaohei turns to the camera and WINKS: one cream ring eye flattens into a single upward-curved cream arc while the other eye stays fully open, head tilts about 8 degrees toward the winking side, that ear dips, then the eye pops back open with a slight overshoot. Slight push-in, brief hold on the wink. Leave space below the head for curved text. Avoid: mouth, lips, teeth, tongue, smile line, nose, whiskers, real cat fur, text, captions, logos, humans, hands, extra eyes, both eyes closing during a wink.
